fallback: 250ms deadline; same-scope approved cache or empty injection
concurrency: host session IDs scoped by adapter and persona; no mutable latent sharing

unverified: derived turn context against a real Claude Code build (PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure signals)

agent_tools: persona_feedback (stdio MCP server, active mode only)
